title: ynh doctor --format json
description: Output of `ynh doctor --format json`. A read-only diagnosis of an ynh setup: vendor CLIs, installed harnesses, project symlinks, the launcher directory, quarantine and Claude hook wiring. doctor never repairs, so every finding carries the command that does. Exit status is 0 even when findings exist; a caller wanting a gate reads summary.errors.

capabilities.description: Wire-protocol version. See CLAUDE.md capability-bump rule.

ynh_version.description: Binary release version or dev-build identifier.

errors.description: Findings with severity error, across all checks.

warnings.description: Findings with severity warn, across all checks.

checks.description: One entry per diagnostic area, ordered by how often each bites.

name.description: Stable identifier for the check. Open set: consumers must tolerate unknown members, per docs/cli-structured.md.

title.description: Human-readable heading used by the text renderer.

status.description: The most severe finding in this check, or ok when it found nothing.

findings.description: Empty when the check ran and found nothing. Never null.

severity.description: error is broken now; warn will bite under some condition; info is context with no action.

subject.description: What the finding is about: a file, harness id, vendor name or path. Absent when the finding concerns the whole check.

remedy.description: The command or action that fixes it. Absent when there is nothing to run.
